QuestInfo.name: In Search of Its Rightful Owner
QuestInfo.0: As soon as you reach Level 30, #b#p1201000##k strikes up a conversation with you...
QuestInfo.1: #p1201000# tells you that the polearm is acting strange and that it might be trying to send you a message. You'd better head to #b#m140000000##k and check on the state of the #bpolearm#k.
QuestInfo.2: Standing in front of the polearm is a strange-looking boy who you've never met before. Who is that? That kid does look a bit familiar. What? That boy is #p1201001#? No way...!

0.0: How is training going? Wow, you've reached such a high level! That's amazing. I knew you would do just fine on Victoria Island... Oh, look at me. I'm wasting your time. I know you're busy, but you'll have to return to the island for a bit.\r\n#e#b(If you accept, you'll travel to the quest map automatically.)#k#n

npc.0: Your #b#p1201001##k in #b#m140000000##k is acting strange all of a sudden. According to the records, the Polearm acts this way when it is calling for its master. #bPerhaps it's calling for you.#k Please return to the island and check things out.
